description: A tool whose CEL `expect:` is always true passes on the first attempt despite `retries:` being configured -- `meta.retries_used` is therefore absent (it is only set once the first attempt is not also the last, win or lose (#421)), the companion of tool-retries-expect-fail (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §7.3, orchestration-reference.md 'tool-expect').
